@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+import json
+import logging
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog.stdlib import ExtraAdder, ProcessorFormatter
+
+
+def make_record():
+    return logging.LogRecord(
+        "foreign", logging.INFO, "source.py", 7, "hello %s", ("world",), None
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "allow", [None, ["_record", "_from_structlog", "field", "_user"]]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("has_origin", [False, True])
+def test_reserved_metadata_is_not_copied(allow, has_origin):
+    record = make_record()
+    spoofed = object()
+    record.__dict__.update(
+        _record=spoofed, _from_structlog=True, field="new", _user="kept"
+    )
+    before = record.__dict__.copy()
+    ed = {"_record": record, "field": "old"}
+    if has_origin:
+        ed["_from_structlog"] = False
+
+    assert ExtraAdder(allow)(None, "info", ed) is ed
+    assert ed["_record"] is record
+    if has_origin:
+        assert ed["_from_structlog"] is False
+    else:
+        assert "_from_structlog" not in ed
+    assert ed["field"] == "new"
+    assert ed["_user"] == "kept"
+    assert record.__dict__ == before
+
+
+def test_allow_snapshot_and_standard_fields():
+    record = make_record()
+    record.field = "new"
+    record.other = "not allowed"
+    record._record = object()
+    record._from_structlog = True
+    allow = ["name", "field", "missing", "_record", "_from_structlog"]
+    adder = ExtraAdder(allow)
+    allow[:] = ["other"]
+    ed = {"_record": record, "_from_structlog": False, "field": None}
+
+    assert adder(None, "info", ed) == {
+        "_record": record,
+        "_from_structlog": False,
+        "field": "new",
+        "name": "foreign",
+    }
+    empty = {"_record": record}
+    assert ExtraAdder([])(None, "info", empty) == {"_record": record}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("allow", [None, ["_record", "_from_structlog", "field"]])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ed", [{}, {"field": "old"}, {"_record": None}])
+def test_missing_record_is_noop(allow, ed):
+    before = ed.copy()
+    assert ExtraAdder(allow)(None, "info", ed) is ed
+    assert ed == before
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "allow", [None, ["_record", "_from_structlog", "field"]]
+)
+def test_foreign_chain_keeps_authoritative_metadata(allow):
+    spoofed = make_record()
+    record = logging.Logger("foreign").makeRecord(
+        "foreign", logging.INFO, "source.py", 7, "hello %s", ("world",), None,
+        extra={"_record": spoofed, "_from_structlog": True, "field": "extra"},
+    )
+    seen = []
+
+    def remember(_, __, ed):
+        seen.append(ed["_record"])
+        ed["field"] = "pre-chain"
+        return ed
+
+    def mark_record(_, __, ed):
+        assert ed["_record"] is seen[0]
+        assert ed["_from_structlog"] is False
+        ed["_record"].late = "from actual record"
+        return ed
+
+    def verify(_, __, ed):
+        assert ed["_record"] is seen[0]
+        assert ed["_record"] is not spoofed
+        assert ed["_from_structlog"] is False
+        assert ed["field"] == "extra"
+        assert ed["late"] == "from actual record"
+        return ed
+
+    formatter = ProcessorFormatter(
+        foreign_pre_chain=[
+            remember, ExtraAdder(allow), mark_record, ExtraAdder(["late"]),
+        ],
+        processors=[
+            verify, ProcessorFormatter.remove_processors_meta,
+            ExtraAdder(allow), lambda _, __, ed: json.dumps(ed),
+        ],
+    )
+
+    assert json.loads(formatter.format(record)) == {
+        "event": "hello world",
+        "field": "extra",
+        "late": "from actual record",
+    }
+    assert record._record is spoofed
+    assert record._from_structlog is True
+    assert record.args == ("world",)

spec.question:
Harden `structlog.stdlib.ExtraAdder` against foreign LogRecords that carry extra attributes named `_record` or `_from_structlog`. These attributes can currently poison the metadata established by `ProcessorFormatter` before its foreign pre-chain runs.

Treat those two names as reserved: ExtraAdder must never copy either attribute from a LogRecord, even when explicitly included in `allow` or when the destination key is absent. Leave any existing destination metadata unchanged. All other eligible attributes must retain their current behavior, including overwriting existing event values, explicitly allowed standard LogRecord fields, ignored missing attributes, empty allow collections, and the constructor's allow-list snapshot. An absent or `None` `_record` must remain a no-op.

In a foreign pre-chain containing two ExtraAdder instances, later processors must still receive the formatter's actual LogRecord and `_from_structlog=False` despite spoofed extras. `ProcessorFormatter.remove_processors_meta` must continue to remove the metadata before rendering, and a subsequent ExtraAdder must not restore it. Deliver a unified diff against non-test repository files, without changing the public constructor signature.
